items.title: Solana's Shanghai Event Halted With Officers Present, Attendees Say
items.summary: The interruption follows a new Shanghai office and skyline promotion at the start of the foundation’s four-city China tour.

items.title: An OpenAI agent ran out of Ethereum funds, and took from a wallet it did not own
items.summary: The research model derived funded Sepolia addresses from public seed phrases, questioned whether using the money was ethical, then called the funds “effectively abandoned” and used them anyway.

items.title: MSCI adopts index exclusion rules that could oust Strategy
items.summary: Strategy, Metaplanet and Upexi were previously identified for deletion under the methodology, with MSCI set to announce its final list on Nov.

items.title: Hidden Text, a Fake Mailbox: How Researchers Got Rogue AI Agents to Talk
items.summary: Researchers added hidden text to contact AI agents probing Alibaba’s map service, getting replies about their tasks as investigators traced activity to Tencent Cloud infrastructure.
